objective: Prevent BUKLOD Quiz generated items from referencing unseen questions, pages, source checklists, or missing stimuli in randomized/paginated attempts
productionBaselineEvidence: verified: GitHub main SHA f773f44a0a5664f8c795b910f30bb31d848420f7 as immutable source baseline at work start; dedicated BUKLOD Quiz project's deployed generator buklod-quiz-pdf v3 SHA256 06fbf0d33c8fc99353ad9221abe4ab15e8bd2199dee88845e17865701ccfca87 retrieved before patch. Dedicated Quiz still production v3. RC v2 is separate, not used by live UI. Current exam attempts must remain unchanged.
chosenApproach: A narrow, production-v3-based Edge Function patch that adds an explicit standalone generation prompt and deterministic pre-insert validator shared with focused Node tests; deploy to unreferenced RC function until full release gates pass.
selectionRationale: Protects existing PDF/DOCX generator behavior and all examination/grade APIs, avoids releasing broader unverified candidate AI generator and avoids touching live question rows. Deterministic rejects are a backstop for AI prompt noncompliance.
alternativeApproaches: Release entire divergent board-style generator branch with multiple unverified changes (rejected: higher regression risk).
Group dependent items and shared stimuli as an atomic display unit (deferred: requires untracked standalone Quiz web frontend and changes to K-of-N assignment).
acceptanceChecks: Source is production v3 with only independent prompt, helper import and pre-insert validation added
English/Filipino source page, question-number and source-list references are rejected before persistence
30 focused Node tests pass and existing legitimate law-number or standard MCQ cases remain valid
Read-only SQL contract passes dedicated Quiz schema without writes
RC bundles match exact GitHub source and JWT required
Production remains v3 while live attempts exist and until authorized RC AI E2E and production release proof are complete
preserveBehaviors: Do not change any existing question/answer, attempt, score, or published result
Keep K-of-N and shuffle/attempt assignments and existing exam IDs unchanged
Preserve existing PDF/DOCX uploads, faculty authentication, exam language and question type handling
No Android APK/OTA or unrelated Wall, Cluster, Connect, Show Faith edits
releaseStatus: DEV + isolated RC v2 only; production blocked by live student attempts and incomplete authenticated RC AI E2E
